best: The USB four-switch buck-boost stage and 3V3 buck read as textbook left-to-right power paths (sense resistor, input caps, bridge, inductor, output bridge, RBAT) with clear block titles and useful notes.
worst: Cells and Gauge: BQ40Z50 inputs arrive via long parallel wire bundles and dangling stub wires (TS2/TS3, ground stubs), with the gauge cluster cramped while the left PACK WIRES area and right notes column leave the sheet unbalanced
USB sheets: small overlaps and pile-ups (R444/R445 ref text on wires, stacked GND pin numbers under U401/U405, '(15)' pin text collision, PD controller I2C nets routed as long multi-wire detours)
3V3 sheet uses only the top-left third of the page, and bulk caps sit as a separate row tied only by a PACK_P power symbol
